# SaneSales

> Free, private sales tracker for indie sellers on Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and Stripe. Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, widgets, menu bar and CSV export.

SaneSales is free under the MIT License. Every feature stays unlocked; donations are optional.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://sanesales.com/)
- [Guides](https://sanesales.com/guides)
- [Support](https://sanesales.com/support)
- [Privacy](https://sanesales.com/privacy)
